narrative:
Inventory Optimization Analysis for Material PL1__MBB420CC:

This material exhibits a intermittent demand pattern with 62.8% working days having non-zero demand.
The demand coefficient of variation is 0.95, indicating high variability.
No significant trend was detected in the demand time series.

Lead time analysis shows a moderate pattern with mean lead time of 0.08 months (1.6 days)
and CV of 0.56. The dominant source of lead time variability is transport.

To achieve the target service level of 95%, a safety stock of 110 units is recommended,
compared to the current SAP setting of 0 units. The recommended order quantity based on EOQ is 361 units
(vs MOQ of 307 units), resulting in a reorder point of 134 units.

The recommended safety lead time is 0.60 days, compared to the current SAP value of
2.50 days. The analysis suggests to decrease the safety lead time.

Cost analysis indicates the optimized policy will result in a total annual cost of $16,413.56,
compared to $12,736.09 under the current SAP policy (delta: $-3,677.47).
The increase in cost is driven by higher safety stock requirements to meet the 95% service level target,
which provides better protection against stockouts.
